newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia govt says close to naming airport buyers.
newsitem.headline: Australia govt says close to naming airport buyers.

text.p: Australian Finance Minister John Fahey said on Wednesday that the government was close to a decision on the privatisation of the Brisbane, Melbourne and Perth airports.
"We are getting fairly close to making a decision on the successful tenderers there," Fahey told Sydney radio 2BL.
"The three airports that are for sale, are getting close to completion," Fahey said.

The Australian government won parliamentary approval for the sale of the country's main airports in September last year and almost immediately advertised throughout the country for bidders for 50-year leases for the first round of airports.
Adelaide airport may also be sold in the 1996/97 year with the remaining airports scheduled to be sold in 1997/98.
Sydney airport and the city's planned second airport are the only possible exceptions to that programme with the sale of their leases delayed as a result of noise and environment studies.
